clips.title: The story
paras: The Dagger Hills form a rugged ridge rising across southern Westfall, directly behind the blighted town of Moonbrook. Long neglected by the crown, this rocky highland serves as a hostile hideout for cutthroats, bandits, and creeping terrors that threaten the surrounding plains.

Rising high above the dilapidated settlement of Moonbrook, the Dagger Hills mark the jagged southern reaches of Westfall. Stripped of official royal patrols from Stormwind, this arid highland has become a natural fortification for the Defias Brotherhood. Knuckledusters, pathstalkers, and highwaymen lurk among the rocky crests and scrub, ambushing unwary travelers and keeping watch over the approaches to their strongholds below.
